# Filipino food photograph credits

Photos are examples of the named dishes; recipes and serving sizes vary. These images do not establish nutrient quantities.

Each resized WebP retains the original photo license shown below. Reuse of a CC BY-SA photo adaptation must follow that photo’s ShareAlike license.
